title: Surprising protein links dietary restriction to increased lifespan in flies
title_zh: 惊人蛋白质将饮食限制与果蝇寿命延长联系起来
abstract: A fruit-fly protein thought only to store amino acids in fact responds to nutritional deficiency in both development and adulthood, resulting in lifespan extension.
abstract_zh: 一种被认为仅用于储存氨基酸的果蝇蛋白，实际上在发育期和成年期都能对营养缺乏作出响应，从而延长寿命。
snippet: A fruit-fly protein thought only to store amino acids in fact responds to nutritional deficiency in both development and adulthood, resulting in lifespan extension.
